snippet.title: Improv Tour Trailer: "Binge It All! The Truth After the Battle of Irontomb!" | Honkai: Star Rail
snippet.description:
The Cosmic Alliance comes face-to-face with Destruction?
The universe's end is approaching?
Trailblazer, it's not time to fall yet!
Story Recap:
What kind of secret could possibly be lurking behind a comic that's been rejected by every major publisher?
From the author of Fluffy Across the Blue, their brand-new procrastination masterpiece is exposed for the first time!
Blowing up across the entire web, ads out the wazoo, the author personally jumping in to commentate themselves into oblivion. Pure sharing, pure torture, pure riding the hype train...
If this made you mad, send your hate mail to "Blurry_QR_Colt"!

English Voice:
Nihilux — Amber Lee Connors
Comic Editor — Faye Mata
